FOR DECADES EXPERTISE, INNOVATION & EXPERIENCE Our mission is to craft, high-quality packaging solutions tailored to your needs, preserving product integrity and extending shelf life to ensure your products reach customers in perfect condition. With four decades of industry expertise, we deliver innovative, customer-focused barrier foil packaging that protects against corrosion, moisture, and environmental damage. Trusted by clients in 60+ countries, our advanced solutions ensure product integrity and extended shelf life. GET IN TOUCH Unmatched Quality, Globally Recognised certified Military performance, Proven Across All industries We’re proud to be the only European manufacturer of military-grade aluminium barrier foil approved by the U.S Department of Defense and listed on the Qualified Products Database . VIEW MILITARY PACKAGING LOOKING FOR BARRIER FOIL SOLUTIONS? OUR PRODUCT RANGE INCLUDES 3D Barrier Bags Heat sealed, hand crafted box bags available in any shape or size. Ideal for protecting heavy or uniquely shaped products during storage, handling, and transit. LEARN MORE Flat Bags and Pouches Tailor made to your specifications, these sleek, space efficient bags safeguard electronic components, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, medical devices, and food ingredients, keeping them protected and ready for use. LEARN MORE Box and Carton Liners Designed to fit within standard cartons and corrugated boxes, creating a sealed micro-environment that guards against atmospheric threats. LEARN MORE Drum and Pail Liners Available for all standard international drum and pail sizes. Designed to deliver secure, contamination-resistant packaging. LEARN MORE FIBC Bulk Bag Liners Integrate seamlessly into Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers (FIBCs), forming a high-barrier internal layer that shields your dry goods. LEARN MORE Octabin Liners Tailored to match the dimensions of your octabins, providing full climatic protection for powders, granules, flakes, and other loose-fill materials. LEARN MORE Thermal Box Liners Designed to reflect radiant heat and insulate contents to reduce thermal gain, helping to stabilise internal temperatures and protect perishable or temperature-sensitive goods. LEARN MORE Zipper Pouches Featuring tamper proof seals and resealable closures, these bags offer uncompromising barrier protection alongside the ease of multiple openings and secure re closings. LEARN MORE 25kg Sacks Engineered for dry, flowable goods—powders, granules, resins, and flakes—these heavy duty sacks enable safe palletisation and stacking while delivering the same premium barrier performance. LEARN MORE 3D Barrier Bags with Zip Combines the high barrier performance of our 3D bags with an integrated zipper for quick, repeated access. Perfect for applications requiring protection, resealability and convenience. LEARN MORE Container Liners Providing industrial-strength defence against humidity, temperature fluctuations, cross-contamination, and residual odours inside 20’, 30’, or 40’ shipping containers. LEARN MORE Rolls, Tubing & Sheets Designed to minimise waste and maximise flexibility, they are ideal for custom packaging formats, from flat sheets to continuous tubing for form-fill-seal (FFS) machines. LEARN MORE Pallet Shrouds & Covers Made to measure for your exact pallet or load configuration. Designed to eliminate the risk of moisture, oxygen, dust and temperature fluctuation which can compromise your product quality and lead to costly damage or rejection. Industry-Leading Expertise & Certified Quality Assurance With over 35 years of experience, Protective Packaging is a global leader in barrier foil packaging solutions. Our commitment to innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction ensures that your products are protected from moisture, corrosion, UV damage, and environmental contaminants. FAST, FLEXIBLE & BESPOKE PACKAGING SOLUTIONS No minimum order quantity means you can order exactly what you need with complete flexibility, with a 24-hour turnaround on production and delivery to meet urgent requirements. Our custom-made packaging solutions provide bespoke designs tailored to your product specifications. PREMIUM QUALITY ALUMINIUM BARRIER FOIL Designed for the highest levels of protection and durability, our aluminium barrier foil laminates represent the pinnacle of innovation in barrier technology and are engineered to meet the most demanding industry standards. QUALITY & EXPERT CONSULTATION Guiding you from R&D to Commercialisation Our specialists are ready to collaborate with you to understand your challenges, provide samples, and develop a solution that works for your specific needs.
